[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] '''Dregg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], Corporal Dregg and two other Mantellian soldiers, Ensigns [[Ta (individual)|Ta]] and [[Peters]], devised a life-or-death game of chance in the region. They challenged refugees in the area to run the mines and gather three unexploded shells. They allowed bets on the outcomes of these runs, and anyone who succeeded was awarded equipment from the relief supplies.<ref name="TOR" />
